blocks.text: Pages are those the project's own search returns for "Uganda", so some only mention it. Views are from July 2015; sizes are the current size of each page.

items.b: 80 pages on Wiktionary (Swahili) mention Uganda, written from 2009 onward and read 5,759 times since July 2015. The median page has been read 9 times.
“nomino za pekee” alone holds 45.5% of all views, and the ten most read pages hold 86%. Readership is highly concentrated, so a few pages decide the story.
Views peaked in 2025 at 2,193. The last full year, 2025, drew 2,193, close to the peak. So far in 2026: 1,679 views.
Most pages were written in 2026 (64). In the last five calendar years (2022–2026, the last one part-way) 73 pages were written, against 0 in the five years before that — the pace is picking up.
20 registered accounts have edited these pages in all. Editors peaked in 2026 (6); in 2025 there were 4. A thin recent base: a handful of people carry the upkeep.
96% of pages are stubs (under 1,000 bytes) and 1% are long (20,000 bytes and over).
“No Wikidata item” affects 80 pages (100%). Suggested action: Connect to Wikidata.
0% of pages are linked to a Wikidata item, and 0% have no Luganda article for the subject — 0 candidates for translation.
98% of pages were edited in the last year; 2 (2%) have not been touched for five years or more.

blocks.text: Pages written, edits and editors come from each page's own edit history, so they reach back to the first page. Views are recorded only from July 2015. Editors are registered accounts, counted once a year.
